classification_audit.abstract: Abstract Radiopharmaceutical therapy (RPT) plays an important role in modern precision oncology. However, treatment activity is still prescribed by fixed-dose protocols rather than adjusted to planned patient-specific absorbed dose (AD). Individualized dosimetry holds promise for improving treatment planning but is not yet standard. One main reason is that present dosimetry workflows depend on repeated imaging at multiple time points and require kinetic modeling and computational modeling. This review covers recent approaches to make dosimetry more practical and easier to use in everyday RPT workflows. We introduce a theoretical framework in which simplification methods, which help ease the clinical burden of dosimetry, are classified into three related categories. The first two categories simplify the process through direct reduction in the burdens of either the acquisition or processing of data: (1) Methodological simplifications through reduction in the imaging burden, such as reduced- or single-time point (STP) imaging; and (2) Computational automation via artificial intelligence (AI) to automate dosimetry, including image processing, segmentation, registration, and AD estimation. Advanced modeling strategies in the third category improve efficiency through inference, thereby enabling estimation of AD from sparsely sampled data. Reduced imaging played a major role in defining these areas. While all of these have their promise, every category of methods has certain drawbacks. STP techniques are less reliable for heterogeneous tumors, black box models have poor transferability and explainability, and digital twin/physiologically-based pharmacokinetic (DT/PBPK) models lack clinical validation. Fundamental dosimetry, with appropriate validity conditions, could allow for reduced reliance on imaging skills and expertise while still retaining sufficient precision for its intended purposes. Standardization of imaging and multicenter analysis is essential for wider adoption of RPTs. A detailed description of models and their effectiveness would be helpful in the clinical application of dosimetry. Keywords: radiopharmaceutical therapy (RPT), theranostics/radiotheranostics, patient-specific dosimetry, single-time-point imaging, digital twins (DTs), physiologically-based pharmacokinetic (PBPK) models, nonlinear mixed-effect (NLME) modeling

放射性药物治疗计划的实践化是精准医学的重要组成部分，但目前仍依赖于固定剂量协议而非根据患者特定吸收剂量（AD）进行调整。个体化剂量学具有潜力，但尚未成为标准。主要原因是当前剂量学流程依赖多次时间点的影像采集和动力学建模与计算建模。本文综述了近期使剂量学更实用、便于日常RPT工作流程的方法。我们提出一个理论框架，将简化方法分为三类：（1）通过减少数据获取或处理负担进行方法简化；（2）利用人工智能自动化剂量学计算；（3）通过推理提高效率，从而从稀疏采样数据中估计AD。减少影像采集在定义这些领域中发挥了重要作用。尽管所有方法都有其潜力，但每种方法都存在一定的缺点。STP技术对异质性肿瘤的可靠性较低，黑箱模型具有较差的可迁移性和可解释性，而数字孪生/生理学基于药代动力学（DT/PBPK）模型缺乏临床验证。基础剂量学在适当的有效条件下可以减少对影像技能和专业知识的依赖，同时仍保持足够的精度用于其目的。影像标准化和多中心分析对于更广泛地采用RPTs至关重要。对模型及其有效性的详细描述将有助于剂量学的临床应用。

items.research_logic: 作者提出假说，即通过简化流程来提高放射性药物治疗计划的实用性。首先，通过减少影像采集负担（如单时间点成像）和计算自动化（如AI辅助剂量估算），降低临床工作量；其次，利用先进建模策略（如推理方法）提升效率，从稀疏数据中估计吸收剂量。这些步骤需区分实验、理论与综述引用，并排除替代解释。例如，STP技术在异质肿瘤中可靠性差，黑盒模型转移性差，DT/PBPK模型缺乏临床验证。综述分析通过组织和比较证据，如表3所示，评估简化方法的准确性、临床挑战、精度等。每一步均需验证其必要性，确保剂量估算的精确性和实用性。
items.own_synthesis: 我的归纳是，本文提出了一种将简化方法分类为三类的理论框架，旨在降低放射性药物治疗中剂量学工作的临床负担。其中，第一类通过减少数据采集或处理的负担实现简化，第二类利用AI自动化剂量计算，第三类通过先进建模策略提高效率。该框架可应用于其他需要精准剂量估算的医疗场景，但需注意其适用边界，如肿瘤异质性、模型可解释性和临床验证不足等问题。
items.selection_reason: 本文综述了放射性药物治疗计划中剂量简化技术的实践应用，强调了通过减少数据采集负担和自动化计算来优化剂量学流程的重要性。文中指出，传统剂量学方法依赖多次影像采集和复杂建模，导致工作量大且难以在日常诊疗中广泛应用。为解决这些问题，文章提出了一系列简化策略，包括减少SPECT扫描时间、降低时间点数量、利用人工智能实现自动化处理以及采用数字孪生/药理动力学模型等。这些方法通过减少影像采集负担和优化计算流程，在保证精度的前提下提高了剂量学工作的可操作性。尽管存在一定的局限性，如单时间点技术在异质肿瘤中的可靠性不足，但整体上这些简化策略为实现个性化剂量学提供了可行路径。
items.application_prospects: 本文探讨了放射性药物治疗中剂量简化技术的应用前景、实现条件及约束。通过减少影像采集时间点和使用深度学习等方法，可有效降低剂量计算的复杂度。然而，单时间点成像在异质肿瘤中可靠性较低，黑盒模型存在迁移性和解释性问题，数字孪生/药代动力学模型缺乏临床验证。因此，需在保证精度的前提下，优化影像标准化和多中心分析以推动放射性药物治疗的广泛应用。
items.future_directions: 本文探讨了放射性药物治疗计划中剂量简化技术的实践应用，指出传统方法依赖多次影像采集和复杂建模，导致效率低下。未来研究可聚焦于开发更高效的自动化算法，如结合深度学习与AI进行剂量计算，以减少对高精度影像的需求。同时，需验证数字孪生/生理学模型在临床中的适用性，并探索多中心数据整合以提升标准化水平。这些方向有助于实现个性化剂量计算的实用化和普及化。

fields.en:
The practical implementation of radiopharmaceutical treatment plans is an important component of precision medicine, but currently still relies on fixed dose protocols rather than adjusting based on the patient-specific absorbed dose (AD). Individualized dosimetry holds potential but has not become standard. The main reason is that current dosimetric workflows depend on multiple time-point imaging acquisitions and kinetic modeling with computational modeling. This paper reviews recent methods that make dosimetry more practical and convenient for daily RPT workflow. We propose a theoretical framework that classifies simplified approaches into three categories: (1) method simplification by reducing data acquisition or processing burden; (2) using artificial intelligence to automate dosimetric calculations; (3) improving efficiency through reasoning, thereby estimating AD from sparse sampling data. Reducing imaging acquisitions has played an important role in defining these areas. Although all methods have potential, each method has certain drawbacks. STP technology has lower reliability for heterogeneous tumors, black-box models have poorer transferability and interpretability, and digital twin/physiological based pharmacokinetic (DT/PBPK) models lack clinical validation. Basic dosimetry can reduce reliance on imaging skills and expertise under appropriate effective conditions while maintaining sufficient accuracy for its purpose. Imaging standardization and multi-center analysis are crucial for the broader adoption of RPTs. Detailed descriptions of the model and its validity will help in the clinical application of dosimetry.

This paper discusses the challenges and limitations in traditional internal dosimetry workflows. RPT makes decision-based activity dose delivery possible, as it considers inter-patient and intra-patient variations, aiming to optimize tumor dose delivery and minimize the impact on OARs. However, there are many clinical and technical challenges in the conventional treatment framework that hinder its routine implementation. Dosage-based personalized treatment can be divided into five key stages, each with its own limitations, thus introducing the simplified approach described in Section 4. These stages include data acquisition, registration and segmentation, AD conversion modeling, integration, and finally the AD calculation.

This paper also discusses methods to reduce the number of imaging time points. MTP imaging has become a barrier to dosimetry in RPT due to its complexity and workload. 放射性药物治疗计划的实践化是精准医学的重要组成部分，但目前仍依赖于固定剂量协议而非根据患者特定吸收剂量（AD）进行调整。个体化剂量学具有潜力，但尚未成为标准。主要原因是当前剂量学流程依赖多次时间点的影像采集和动力学建模与计算建模。本文综述了近期使剂量学更实用、便于日常RPT工作流程的方法。我们提出一个理论框架，将简化方法分为三类：（1）通过减少数据获取或处理负担进行方法简化；（2）利用人工智能自动化剂量学计算；（3）通过推理提高效率，从而从稀疏采样数据中估计AD。减少影像采集在定义这些领域中发挥了重要作用。尽管所有方法都有其潜力，但每种方法都存在一定的缺点。STP技术对异质性肿瘤的可靠性较低，黑箱模型具有较差的可迁移性和可解释性，而数字孪生/生理学基于药代动力学（DT/PBPK）模型缺乏临床验证。基础剂量学在适当的有效条件下可以减少对影像技能和专业知识的依赖，同时仍保持足够的精度用于其目的。影像标准化和多中心分析对于更广泛地采用RPTs至关重要。对模型及其有效性的详细描述将有助于剂量学的临床应用。

paragraphs.en: The practical implementation of radiopharmaceutical treatment plans is an important component of precision medicine, but currently still relies on fixed dose protocols rather than adjusting based on the patient-specific absorbed dose (AD). Individualized dosimetry holds potential but has not become standard. The main reason is that current dosimetric workflows depend on multiple time-point imaging acquisitions and kinetic modeling with computational modeling. This paper reviews recent methods that make dosimetry more practical and convenient for daily RPT workflow. We propose a theoretical framework that classifies simplified approaches into three categories: (1) method simplification by reducing data acquisition or processing burden; (2) using artificial intelligence to automate dosimetric calculations; (3) improving efficiency through reasoning, thereby estimating AD from sparse sampling data. Reducing imaging acquisitions has played an important role in defining these areas. Although all methods have potential, each method has certain drawbacks. STP technology has lower reliability for heterogeneous tumors, black-box models have poorer transferability and interpretability, and digital twin/physiological based pharmacokinetic (DT/PBPK) models lack clinical validation. Basic dosimetry can reduce reliance on imaging skills and expertise under appropriate effective conditions while maintaining sufficient accuracy for its purpose. Imaging standardization and multi-center analysis are crucial for the broader adoption of RPTs. Detailed descriptions of the model and its validity will help in the clinical application of dosimetry.

paragraphs.en: This paper discusses the challenges and limitations in traditional internal dosimetry workflows. RPT makes decision-based activity dose delivery possible, as it considers inter-patient and intra-patient variations, aiming to optimize tumor dose delivery and minimize the impact on OARs. However, there are many clinical and technical challenges in the conventional treatment framework that hinder its routine implementation. Dosage-based personalized treatment can be divided into five key stages, each with its own limitations, thus introducing the simplified approach described in Section 4. These stages include data acquisition, registration and segmentation, AD conversion modeling, integration, and finally the AD calculation.

fields.en: The author proposes a hypothesis that simplifying the process can enhance the practicality of radiopharmaceutical treatment plans. First, by reducing the burden of image acquisition (such as single-time-point imaging) and computational automation (such as AI-assisted dose estimation), clinical workload is reduced; second, by utilizing advanced modeling strategies (such as reasoning methods) to improve efficiency, absorption doses can be estimated from sparse data. These steps require distinguishing between experimental, theoretical, and review citations, and excluding alternative explanations. For example, STP technology has poor reliability in heterogeneous tumors, black-box models have poor transferability, and DT/PBPK models lack clinical validation. Review analysis evaluates the accuracy, clinical challenges, precision, etc., of simplified methods, as shown in Table 3. Each step must be verified for its necessity to ensure the accuracy and practicality of dose estimation.

fields.en: This paper reviews the practical application of dose simplification techniques in radiopharmaceutical treatment plans, emphasizing the importance of optimizing the dosimetry process by reducing the burden of data acquisition and automating calculations. The text points out that traditional dosimetry methods rely on multiple imaging acquisitions and complex modeling, leading to a large workload and difficulty in widespread application in routine clinical practice. To address these issues, the article proposes a series of simplification strategies, including reducing the duration of SPECT scans, decreasing the number of time points, utilizing artificial intelligence for automated processing, and adopting digital twin/pharmacokinetic models. These methods reduce the burden of imaging data acquisition and optimize computational processes, enhancing the operability of dosimetry while maintaining accuracy. Although there are certain limitations, such as the reliability of single-time-point techniques in heterogeneous tumors, overall these simplification strategies provide a feasible path for achieving personalized dosimetry.

fields.en: This paper explores the prospects, implementation conditions, and constraints of dose simplification techniques in radiopharmaceutical therapy. By reducing the number of imaging time points and using methods such as deep learning, the complexity of dose calculation can be effectively reduced. However, single-time-point imaging has lower reliability in heterogeneous tumors, black-box models have issues with transferability and interpretability, and digital twin/pharmacokinetic models lack clinical validation. Therefore, it is necessary to optimize image standardization and multi-center analysis while ensuring accuracy to promote the widespread application of radiopharmaceutical therapy.

fields.en: This paper explores the practical application of dose simplification techniques in radiotherapy treatment plans, pointing out that traditional methods rely on multiple image acquisitions and complex modeling, leading to inefficiency. Future research can focus on developing more efficient automated algorithms, such as combining deep learning with AI for dose calculation, to reduce the need for high-precision imaging. At the same time, it is necessary to verify the applicability of digital twin/physiological models in clinical settings and explore multi-center data integration to enhance standardization. decisions.focus: Human breath as a carbon dioxide source for organic synthesis

The study presents a novel approach to utilizing human breath as a CO2 source for organic synthesis, demonstrating the efficient preparation of urea compounds under solvent-free conditions. The research provides direct evidence for CO2 capture from human breath by primary amines and shows the utility of these urea compounds as co-catalysts in CO2 fixation reactions with epoxides. This work represents a significant contribution to chemical biology and sustainable organic synthesis, offering practical applications for carbon utilization in space and other resource-limited environments.

classification_audit.abstract: The capture and utilization of low-concentration CO 2 as a C1 feedstock for organic synthesis have emerged as important research areas. Although atmospheric CO 2 is an ideal carbon source for sustainable organic transformations, its extremely low concentration (0.04%) presents a significant challenge to the development of efficient CO 2 conversion processes. In this context, we turned our attention to human breath as an alternative CO 2 source, which contains approximately 4% CO 2 . The capture and utilization of CO 2 from human breath is also expected to play an important role in sustaining life in space, where readily available carbon sources are scarce and exhaled CO 2 represents a valuable renewable carbon resource for life-support systems. Herein, we demonstrate that human breath can serve as a practical and readily available CO 2 source for the efficient synthesis of urea compounds. Furthermore, the prepared urea compounds proved to be effective co-catalysts for the CO 2 fixation with epoxides under pure CO 2 .

人类呼吸作为有机合成的二氧化碳来源的研究表明，利用人体呼出的二氧化碳进行有机合成具有实际应用价值。该研究通过高效制备尿素化合物，证明了人体呼吸可以作为一种便捷且可获得的二氧化碳源用于有机合成。在实验中，使用人体呼吸作为二氧化碳来源，在无溶剂条件下成功合成了多种尿素化合物，并验证了其作为共催化剂在二氧化碳与环氧乙烷反应中的作用。研究还发现，当使用四丁基碘化铵和尿素化合物作为双催化体系时，能够高效促进二氧化碳与环氧乙烷的固定反应，生成高产率的环状碳酸酯。此外，该方法在常压下无需使用高压釜即可实现无溶剂条件下的二氧化碳固定，降低了能耗。研究还指出，尽管人体呼吸中的水分含量较低，但尿素化合物合成过程对水分的影响不大。然而，该方法在胺类底物的应用范围上仍存在一定的局限性。综上所述，利用人体呼吸作为二氧化碳来源进行有机合成不仅具有环境友好性，而且在航天等特殊环境中也具有重要的应用前景。

研究中通过NMR分析提供了直接证据，证明了尿素化合物的形成与人体呼吸中的二氧化碳捕获有关。实验表明，在无溶剂条件下，使用人体呼吸作为二氧化碳源可以高效合成多种尿素化合物，并且这些尿素化合物在作为共催化剂时能够显著促进二氧化碳与环氧乙烷的反应。此外，研究还发现，当使用四丁基碘化铵和尿素化合物作为双催化体系时，能够有效提高反应效率，生成高产率的环状碳酸酯。该方法不仅适用于有机合成，而且在航天等特殊环境中也具有重要的应用价值。

综上所述，本研究成功证明了人体呼吸可以作为一种实用的二氧化碳来源用于有机合成，并且通过高效制备尿素化合物，验证了其作为共催化剂在二氧化碳与环氧乙烷反应中的作用。该方法不仅具有环境友好性，而且在航天等特殊环境中也具有重要的应用前景。
items.research_logic: 作者通过实验验证了人体呼吸作为CO₂来源的可行性。首先，通过合成二辛脲（2a）证明了人体呼吸中CO₂可被氨基捕获并转化为有机物（p3, p5, p7）。随后，通过NMR分析确认了CO₂与氨基反应生成加成物（p6, p7, p8），进一步验证了CO₂的捕获过程。接着，利用合成的脲类化合物作为共催化剂，在纯CO₂条件下促进环氧乙烷与CO₂的固定反应（p10, p11）。通过对比不同条件下的反应效率，证明了人体呼吸作为CO₂来源的优势。综述分析中，作者系统比较了不同CO₂源的捕获效率和应用前景，强调了人体呼吸在空间生命维持中的潜在价值（p2, p9, p12）。每一步实验均通过重复性测试和对照组验证，确保结果可靠性；同时排除了水蒸气等干扰因素的影响。
items.own_synthesis: 我的归纳是，利用人体呼吸作为二氧化碳来源进行有机合成具有可行性，且该方法在无溶剂条件下可高效实现。实验表明，通过人体呼吸捕获的二氧化碳能够与一级胺反应生成尿素类化合物，并作为共催化剂促进二氧化碳与环氧乙烷的固定反应。此设计适用于低浓度二氧化碳资源的利用，但需注意水蒸气和反应条件对产物的影响。
items.selection_reason: 本研究通过利用人体呼吸作为二氧化碳来源，成功实现了有机合成中的高效尿素化合物制备，并展示了其在CO₂固定反应中的应用。人体呼吸中CO₂浓度约为4%，显著高于空气中的0.04%，为有机合成提供了便捷的碳源。实验表明，在无溶剂条件下，通过人体呼吸可高效生成尿素化合物，且该方法具有良好的重复性和稳定性。此外，所制备的尿素化合物作为共催化剂，能有效促进CO₂与环氧物的固定反应，提高产物收率。本研究不仅展示了人体呼吸作为碳源的可行性，也为可持续化学提供了新思路。
items.application_prospects: 本文展示了人类呼吸作为二氧化碳来源在有机合成中的应用前景。通过高效制备尿素化合物，证明了人类呼吸可作为实用的CO₂源进行有机合成。该方法在无溶剂条件下实现，且对水蒸气不敏感。尿素化合物还可作为共催化剂促进CO₂与环氧乙烷的固定反应，在纯CO₂环境中有效提升反应效率。然而，该方法对胺类底物存在一定限制。
items.future_directions: 本文研究了人体呼吸作为尿素合成的二氧化碳来源，并展示了其在有机合成中的实用性。通过人体呼吸获取的二氧化碳可高效合成尿素化合物，且这些尿素化合物能作为共催化剂促进二氧化碳与环氧乙烷的固定反应。未来可进一步探索人体呼吸作为C1源在制备有价值有机化合物中的应用，例如开发更高效的催化体系或优化反应条件以提高产率和选择性。

fields.en:
Studies on human respiration as a source of carbon dioxide for organic synthesis indicate that using carbon dioxide exhaled by humans for organic synthesis has practical application value. This research demonstrates that human respiration can serve as a convenient and accessible source of carbon dioxide for organic synthesis through the efficient preparation of urea compounds. In the experiments, using human respiration as a carbon dioxide source, multiple urea compounds were successfully synthesized under solvent-free conditions, and their role as co-catalysts in the reaction of carbon dioxide with ethylene oxide was verified. The study also found that when tetramethylammonium iodide and urea compounds are used as a dual catalytic system, they can efficiently promote the fixation reaction of carbon dioxide with ethylene oxide, generating high-yield cyclic carbonates. Furthermore, this method achieves carbon dioxide fixation under atmospheric pressure without the need for a high-pressure reactor, reducing energy consumption. The study also points out that although the water content in human respiration is low, the synthesis process of urea compounds is not significantly affected by water. However, there are still certain limitations in the application range of this method for amine substrates. In conclusion, using human respiration as a source of carbon dioxide for organic synthesis not only has environmental friendliness but also has important application prospects in special environments such as space.

The study provided direct evidence through NMR analysis, proving that the formation of urea compounds is related to the capture of carbon dioxide in human respiration. The experiments showed that under solvent-free conditions, using human respiration as a carbon dioxide source can efficiently synthesize various urea compounds, and these urea compounds can significantly promote the reaction between carbon dioxide and ethylene oxide when acting as co-catalysts. Furthermore, the study found that using tetramethylammonium iodide and urea compounds as a dual catalytic system can effectively enhance reaction efficiency, producing high-yield cyclic carbonates. This method is not only applicable to organic synthesis but also has important application value in special environments such as space travel.

In summary, this study successfully demonstrated that human respiration can serve as a practical source of carbon dioxide for organic synthesis, and verified the role of urea compounds as co-catalysts in the reaction of carbon dioxide with ethylene oxide. The method not only exhibits environmental friendliness but also holds significant application prospects in special environments such as space.

This method is not only applicable to organic synthesis but also has important application value in special environments such as space travel.
paragraphs.zh: 研究中通过NMR分析提供了直接证据，证明了尿素化合物的形成与人体呼吸中的二氧化碳捕获有关。实验表明，在无溶剂条件下，使用人体呼吸作为二氧化碳源可以高效合成多种尿素化合物，并且这些尿素化合物在作为共催化剂时能够显著促进二氧化碳与环氧乙烷的反应。此外，研究还发现，当使用四丁基碘化铵和尿素化合物作为双催化体系时，能够有效提高反应效率，生成高产率的环状碳酸酯。该方法不仅适用于有机合成，而且在航天等特殊环境中也具有重要的应用价值。

paragraphs.en: In summary, this study successfully demonstrated that human respiration can serve as a practical source of carbon dioxide for organic synthesis, and verified the role of urea compounds as co-catalysts in the reaction of carbon dioxide with ethylene oxide. The method not only exhibits environmental friendliness but also holds significant application prospects in special environments such as space.
paragraphs.zh: 综上所述，本研究成功证明了人体呼吸可以作为一种实用的二氧化碳来源用于有机合成，并且通过高效制备尿素化合物，验证了其作为共催化剂在二氧化碳与环氧乙烷反应中的作用。该方法不仅具有环境友好性，而且在航天等特殊环境中也具有重要的应用前景。

fields.en: The author verified the feasibility of human respiration as a source of CO₂ through experiments. First, it was proven that CO₂ from human respiration could be captured and converted into organic compounds by amino groups through the synthesis of dodecylurea (2a) (p3, p5, p7). Subsequently, NMR analysis confirmed that CO₂ reacted with amino groups to form adducts (p6, p7, p8), further verifying the capture process of CO₂. Then, using the synthesized urea-like compounds as co-catalysts, the fixation reaction of ethylene oxide with CO₂ was promoted under pure CO₂ conditions (p10, p11). By comparing the reaction efficiency under different conditions, it was proven that human respiration has advantages as a source of CO₂. In the review analysis, the author systematically compared the capture efficiency and application prospects of different CO₂ sources, emphasizing the potential value of human respiration in space life support (p2, p9, p12). Each experimental step was verified through repeatability tests and control group validation to ensure the reliability of the results; at the same time, the influence of interfering factors such as water vapor was excluded.
fields.zh: 作者通过实验验证了人体呼吸作为CO₂来源的可行性。首先，通过合成二辛脲（2a）证明了人体呼吸中CO₂可被氨基捕获并转化为有机物（p3, p5, p7）。随后，通过NMR分析确认了CO₂与氨基反应生成加成物（p6, p7, p8），进一步验证了CO₂的捕获过程。接着，利用合成的脲类化合物作为共催化剂，在纯CO₂条件下促进环氧乙烷与CO₂的固定反应（p10, p11）。通过对比不同条件下的反应效率，证明了人体呼吸作为CO₂来源的优势。综述分析中，作者系统比较了不同CO₂源的捕获效率和应用前景，强调了人体呼吸在空间生命维持中的潜在价值（p2, p9, p12）。每一步实验均通过重复性测试和对照组验证，确保结果可靠性；同时排除了水蒸气等干扰因素的影响。

fields.en: My conclusion is that using human respiration as a source of carbon dioxide for organic synthesis is feasible, and the method can efficiently achieve this under solvent-free conditions. Experiments show that carbon dioxide captured from human respiration can react with primary amines to form urea-like compounds, and these can act as co-catalysts to promote the fixation reaction of carbon dioxide with ethylene oxide. This design is suitable for utilizing low-concentration carbon dioxide resources, but attention should be paid to the effects of water vapor and reaction conditions on the product.
fields.zh: 我的归纳是，利用人体呼吸作为二氧化碳来源进行有机合成具有可行性，且该方法在无溶剂条件下可高效实现。实验表明，通过人体呼吸捕获的二氧化碳能够与一级胺反应生成尿素类化合物，并作为共催化剂促进二氧化碳与环氧乙烷的固定反应。此设计适用于低浓度二氧化碳资源的利用，但需注意水蒸气和反应条件对产物的影响。

fields.label_zh: 推荐理由与创新点（详细）
fields.en: This study successfully achieved efficient preparation of organic compounds through the utilization of human respiration as a carbon dioxide source, and demonstrated its application in CO₂ fixation reactions. The concentration of CO₂ in human respiration is approximately 4%, significantly higher than that in air (0.04%), providing a convenient carbon source for organic synthesis. Experimental results showed that urea compounds could be efficiently synthesized under solvent-free conditions using human respiration, and the method exhibited good repeatability and stability. Furthermore, the prepared urea compounds, as co-catalysts, effectively promote the fixation reaction of CO₂ with epoxides, increasing the yield of the product. This study not only demonstrated the feasibility of using human respiration as a carbon source but also provided new insights for sustainable chemistry.
fields.zh: 本研究通过利用人体呼吸作为二氧化碳来源，成功实现了有机合成中的高效尿素化合物制备，并展示了其在CO₂固定反应中的应用。人体呼吸中CO₂浓度约为4%，显著高于空气中的0.04%，为有机合成提供了便捷的碳源。实验表明，在无溶剂条件下，通过人体呼吸可高效生成尿素化合物，且该方法具有良好的重复性和稳定性。此外，所制备的尿素化合物作为共催化剂，能有效促进CO₂与环氧物的固定反应，提高产物收率。本研究不仅展示了人体呼吸作为碳源的可行性，也为可持续化学提供了新思路。

fields.en: This paper demonstrates the potential application of human respiration as a source of carbon dioxide in organic synthesis. By efficiently preparing urea compounds, it is proven that human respiration can serve as a practical CO₂ source for organic synthesis. The method is achieved under solvent-free conditions and is insensitive to water vapor. Urea compounds can also act as co-catalysts to promote the fixation reaction of CO₂ with ethylene oxide, effectively enhancing reaction efficiency in pure CO₂ environments. However, this method has certain limitations with amine substrates.

fields.en: This study investigates human respiration as a source of carbon dioxide for the synthesis of urea and demonstrates its practicality in organic synthesis. Carbon dioxide obtained from human respiration can efficiently synthesize urea compounds, which can act as co-catalysts to promote the fixation reaction of carbon dioxide with ethylene oxide. Future research could further explore the application of human respiration as a C1 source in the preparation of valuable organic compounds, such as developing more efficient catalytic systems or optimizing reaction conditions to improve yield and selectivity.

decisions.focus: Polymer fibrous aerogels for thermal insulation: from molecular building blocks to structural reliability

This review provides a comprehensive analysis of polymer fibrous aerogels for thermal insulation, emphasizing the importance of structural reliability and service performance over pristine material properties. It critically evaluates how molecular design, fiber formation, three-dimensional assembly, interfiber stabilization, and drying influence heat transfer pathways, particularly under real-world conditions like deformation, humidity, and fire exposure. The review highlights the need for a processing–structure–transport–retention framework to translate laboratory specimens into reproducible insulation systems with verifiable service reliability.

evidence.text: Cellulose is the most extensively investigated renewable precursor for polymer fibrous aerogels because it is available as cellulose nanofibrils, bacterial-cellulose ribbons, regenerated microfilaments, pulp fibers, and short natural fibers. These forms perform different structural functions. Nanofibrils generate numerous contact points and form continuous skeletons at low solid contents, whereas microfilaments and short fibers span larger pores and distribute stress over longer distances. Polyimides (PIs) provide a broad molecular-design space because the rigidity, symmetry, polarity, and steric configuration of dianhydride and diamine units can regulate chain packing, imidization shrinkage, thermal stability, and pore retention. However, these molecular advantages contribute to insulation only when they are translated into an appropriate fibrous architecture. The polymer must first be converted into fibers or fibrils with sufficient aspect ratio, then dispersed or deposited without severe aggregation, and finally stabilized at fiber contacts without filling the surrounding pore space. classification_audit.abstract: Abstract Polymer fibrous aerogels combine the low density and high porosity of conventional aerogels with the continuity and deformability of fibrous networks, offering a route to lightweight thermal protection that can remain mechanically compliant. Their design is intrinsically coupled: reducing solid content, refining pores, strengthening junctions, or introducing functional phases can suppress one heat-transfer pathway while intensifying another or destabilizing the network. This review adopts retained thermal insulation after service exposure, rather than the minimum conductivity of the pristine specimen, as its central evaluation criterion. We trace how polymer chemistry, fiber formation, three-dimensional assembly, interfiber stabilization, and drying govern solid and gas conduction, thermal radiation, residual convection, and moisture-mediated transport, and how these pathways evolve after deformation, humidity, heating, and fire exposure. Cellulose-based, other bio-derived, aramid, PBO, polyimide, polyamide-imide, thermoplastic, and char-forming systems are compared using measurable structural descriptors and matched test conditions rather than composition labels alone. Across these material classes, durable insulation emerges within a structural window of sparse load-bearing fibers, localized mechanically effective junctions, controlled pore connectivity, and spatially confined functional phases. The resulting processing–structure–transport–retention framework identifies the evidence required to translate polymer fibrous aerogels from record-setting laboratory specimens into reproducible insulation systems with verifiable service reliability.

聚合物纤维气凝胶在热绝缘中的应用，从分子构建块到结构可靠性，是当前材料科学的一个重要研究方向。该综述指出，传统材料在热绝缘方面面临多重挑战，包括质量、厚度、变形、湿度和火灾暴露等限制。聚合物纤维气凝胶因其低密度、高孔隙率以及连续性和可变形性，为轻质热保护提供了新的可能。其设计本质上是相互关联的：减少固体含量、细化孔隙、加强连接点或引入功能相可以抑制一个传热路径，同时增强另一个或破坏网络结构。综述采用服务暴露后的保留热绝缘作为核心评估标准，而非原始样品的最小导热性。通过分析聚合物化学、纤维形成、三维组装、纤维间稳定和干燥过程，揭示了固体和气体传导、热辐射、残留对流以及湿度介导传输之间的关系，并探讨这些路径在变形、湿度、加热和火灾暴露后的演变。不同材料类别如纤维素基、其他生物来源、芳纶、PBO、聚酰亚胺、聚酰胺-酰亚胺、热塑性及形变形成系统，通过可测量的结构描述符和匹配测试条件进行比较，而非仅依赖组成标签。在这些材料中，耐用绝缘在稀疏承重纤维、局部机械有效连接点、受控孔隙连通性和空间限定功能相的结构窗口内显现。由此形成的加工-结构-传输-保留框架识别了将聚合物纤维气凝胶从实验室记录样本转化为可重复的保温系统所需证据。

综述指出，合适的聚合物应满足四个相互关联的要求：能够加工成高长径比纤维、在纤维接触处提供可控相互作用、抵抗热和环境松弛，并保持低体积分数的传热网络。这些要求很少能在单一分子特征中同时实现。刚性骨架提高热稳定性但复杂化加工；极性基团辅助组装但促进水分吸收；可交联基团加强连接点但可能致密化网络。有效的分子设计依赖于平衡这些竞争效应，并通过共聚、表面修饰、混合或局部交联分离其功能。最佳前驱体不是分解温度最高的聚合物，而是其分子结构能可重复地转化为稀疏且良好连接的纤维网络，在预期的热、机械和潮湿条件下保持稳定。

综述还指出，纤维素基系统通过界面工程强化纤维素纳米纤维与硅烷衍生成分之间的接触，形成具有强各向异性的网络。其他生物来源系统如玉米杆和稻壳系统展示了化学处理如何改变农业纤维骨架的组成和连续性。天然空心纤维提供了一种互补策略，在保留原始生物几何形状的同时避免过度纤化或碳化。这些研究揭示了从基于成分的修改向有意控制网络拓扑结构的转变，其对孔隙介导和定向传热的影响在后续章节中分析。
items.research_logic: 作者提出假说，即聚合物纤维气凝胶通过分子设计、纤维形成、三维组装和干燥过程控制热传导路径，从而实现持续的热绝缘。该假说通过比较不同材料体系的结构特征和测试条件来验证，强调了网络稳定性与孔隙连通性的关系。作者指出，有效的分子设计需要平衡不同功能组的协同作用，并通过共聚、表面修饰等方法分离其功能。综述分析采用可测量的结构描述符和匹配的测试条件，而非仅依赖组成标签，以确保比较的客观性。通过分析纤维接触强度、孔隙分布和热传导路径的变化，作者验证了材料在服务暴露下的可靠性。每一步分析均基于原文提供的证据，如p12中提到的机械可靠性由关键纤维连接点的强度和空间分布决定，而非整体固含量增加；p28中通过控制氢键形成和再质子化实现网络稳定性；p34中通过分层结构分离功能以避免整体致密化。这些步骤确保了从实验室样品到可重复使用的绝缘系统的转化。
items.own_synthesis: 我的归纳是，聚合物纤维气凝胶的实验设计应围绕网络形成与稳定机制，而非单一材料属性。通过控制纤维接触、孔隙连通性及功能相分布，可在保持低热导的同时实现结构可靠性。该原则适用于其他多孔材料系统，如生物衍生或复合材料，在确保机械性能与环境适应性的前提下优化热绝缘性能。
items.selection_reason: 该论文从分子设计到结构可靠性全面分析了聚合物纤维气凝胶的热绝缘性能，强调其在服务暴露后仍能保持良好保温效果。通过对比不同材料体系，指出应以结构稳定性为核心标准，而非单纯依赖原始样品导热系数。文中提出的关键在于平衡网络形成、界面稳定性和孔隙控制，确保在变形、湿度和火情下仍能维持低热传导路径。例如，纤维素基系统通过优化接触点和孔隙连通性实现高耐久性；芳纶和PBO体系则通过精确调控分子间作用力提升机械性能与防火能力。这些设计原则超越了传统流水线工作模式，强调材料特性与结构功能的协同优化，而非依赖单一性能指标。
items.application_prospects: 本文探讨了聚合物纤维气凝胶在热绝缘领域的应用前景，强调其通过分子设计和结构控制实现低导热性和持久孔隙架构的潜力。该材料需在保持稀疏纤维骨架、局部有效连接点、可控孔连通性及空间限域功能相的情况下，满足服务环境下的稳定性与可靠性。实验表明，通过优化纤维形成、界面稳定和干燥工艺，可实现高效热绝缘性能。然而，其应用受限于材料的加工条件、环境适应性和结构稳定性，需在分子设计与工艺控制间取得平衡。
items.future_directions: 未来研究应聚焦于如何通过分子设计和界面工程优化纤维网络的稳定性与热传导路径控制，特别是在高湿度、高温及火暴露条件下。需探索不同材料体系在服务寿命内的结构保持机制，并验证其在实际应用中的可靠性。此外，应进一步研究如何通过定向干燥和局部交联实现各向异性网络的可控构建，以提升热绝缘性能与机械强度。

fields.en:
The application of polymer fiber aerogels in thermal insulation, from molecular building blocks to structural reliability, is an important research direction in current materials science. The review highlights that traditional materials face multiple challenges in thermal insulation, including limitations related to mass, thickness, deformation, humidity, and fire exposure. Polymer fiber aerogels, due to their low density, high porosity, and continuity and deformability, offer new possibilities for lightweight thermal protection. Their design is inherently interrelated: reducing solid content, refining pores, strengthening connection points, or introducing functional phases can inhibit one heat transfer pathway while enhancing another or disrupting the network structure. The review uses retained thermal insulation after service exposure as a core evaluation criterion, rather than the minimum thermal conductivity of the original sample. By analyzing polymer chemistry, fiber formation, three-dimensional assembly, inter-fiber stability, and drying processes, the relationships between solid and gas conduction, thermal radiation, residual convection, and humidity-mediated transport are revealed, along with the evolution of these pathways after deformation, humidity, heating, and fire exposure. Different material classes, such as cellulose-based, other biological sources, aramid, PBO, polyimide, polyamide-imide, thermoplastic, and deformation-forming systems, are compared through measurable structural descriptors and matched test conditions, rather than solely relying on compositional labels. Within these materials, durable insulation is evident in the structural window of sparse load-bearing fibers, local mechanical effective connection points, controlled pore connectivity, and spatially confined functional phases. The resulting processing-structure-transport-retention framework identifies the evidence required to transform polymer fiber aerogels from lab-recorded samples into repeatable insulating systems.

The review highlights that suitable polymers should meet four interrelated requirements: the ability to process into high aspect ratio fibers, providing controllable interactions at fiber contacts, resistance to thermal and environmental relaxation, and maintaining a low volume fraction of the heat transfer network. These requirements are rarely simultaneously achievable in a single molecular feature. Rigid backbones enhance thermal stability but complicate processing; polar groups assist assembly but promote water absorption; crosslinkable groups strengthen connection points but may densify the network. Effective molecular design depends on balancing these competing effects and separating their functions through copolymerization, surface modification, blending, or local crosslinking. The optimal precursor is not the polymer with the highest decomposition temperature, but rather one whose molecular structure can repeatedly convert into a sparse yet well-connected fiber network, remaining stable under anticipated thermal, mechanical, and wet conditions.

The review also highlights that cellulose-based systems enhance the contact between cellulose nanofibers and silane-derived components through interface engineering, forming a network with strong anisotropy. Other biologically sourced systems, such as corn stalk and rice husk systems, demonstrate how chemical treatment alters the composition and continuity of agricultural fiber frameworks. Natural hollow fibers provide a complementary strategy that preserves the original biological geometry while avoiding excessive fibrillation or carbonization. These studies reveal a shift from component-based modifications to intentional control of network topological structures, with the effects of pore-mediated and directed heat transfer analyzed in subsequent chapters.

paragraphs.zh: 聚合物纤维气凝胶在热绝缘中的应用，从分子构建块到结构可靠性，是当前材料科学的一个重要研究方向。该综述指出，传统材料在热绝缘方面面临多重挑战，包括质量、厚度、变形、湿度和火灾暴露等限制。聚合物纤维气凝胶因其低密度、高孔隙率以及连续性和可变形性，为轻质热保护提供了新的可能。其设计本质上是相互关联的：减少固体含量、细化孔隙、加强连接点或引入功能相可以抑制一个传热路径，同时增强另一个或破坏网络结构。综述采用服务暴露后的保留热绝缘作为核心评估标准，而非原始样品的最小导热性。通过分析聚合物化学、纤维形成、三维组装、纤维间稳定和干燥过程，揭示了固体和气体传导、热辐射、残留对流以及湿度介导传输之间的关系，并探讨这些路径在变形、湿度、加热和火灾暴露后的演变。不同材料类别如纤维素基、其他生物来源、芳纶、PBO、聚酰亚胺、聚酰胺-酰亚胺、热塑性及形变形成系统，通过可测量的结构描述符和匹配测试条件进行比较，而非仅依赖组成标签。在这些材料中，耐用绝缘在稀疏承重纤维、局部机械有效连接点、受控孔隙连通性和空间限定功能相的结构窗口内显现。由此形成的加工-结构-传输-保留框架识别了将聚合物纤维气凝胶从实验室记录样本转化为可重复的保温系统所需证据。

paragraphs.en: The review highlights that suitable polymers should meet four interrelated requirements: the ability to process into high aspect ratio fibers, providing controllable interactions at fiber contacts, resistance to thermal and environmental relaxation, and maintaining a low volume fraction of the heat transfer network. These requirements are rarely simultaneously achievable in a single molecular feature. Rigid backbones enhance thermal stability but complicate processing; polar groups assist assembly but promote water absorption; crosslinkable groups strengthen connection points but may densify the network. Effective molecular design depends on balancing these competing effects and separating their functions through copolymerization, surface modification, blending, or local crosslinking. The optimal precursor is not the polymer with the highest decomposition temperature, but rather one whose molecular structure can repeatedly convert into a sparse yet well-connected fiber network, remaining stable under anticipated thermal, mechanical, and wet conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 综述指出，合适的聚合物应满足四个相互关联的要求：能够加工成高长径比纤维、在纤维接触处提供可控相互作用、抵抗热和环境松弛，并保持低体积分数的传热网络。这些要求很少能在单一分子特征中同时实现。刚性骨架提高热稳定性但复杂化加工；极性基团辅助组装但促进水分吸收；可交联基团加强连接点但可能致密化网络。有效的分子设计依赖于平衡这些竞争效应，并通过共聚、表面修饰、混合或局部交联分离其功能。最佳前驱体不是分解温度最高的聚合物，而是其分子结构能可重复地转化为稀疏且良好连接的纤维网络，在预期的热、机械和潮湿条件下保持稳定。

paragraphs.en: The review also highlights that cellulose-based systems enhance the contact between cellulose nanofibers and silane-derived components through interface engineering, forming a network with strong anisotropy. Other biologically sourced systems, such as corn stalk and rice husk systems, demonstrate how chemical treatment alters the composition and continuity of agricultural fiber frameworks. Natural hollow fibers provide a complementary strategy that preserves the original biological geometry while avoiding excessive fibrillation or carbonization. These studies reveal a shift from component-based modifications to intentional control of network topological structures, with the effects of pore-mediated and directed heat transfer analyzed in subsequent chapters.
paragraphs.zh: 综述还指出，纤维素基系统通过界面工程强化纤维素纳米纤维与硅烷衍生成分之间的接触，形成具有强各向异性的网络。其他生物来源系统如玉米杆和稻壳系统展示了化学处理如何改变农业纤维骨架的组成和连续性。天然空心纤维提供了一种互补策略，在保留原始生物几何形状的同时避免过度纤化或碳化。这些研究揭示了从基于成分的修改向有意控制网络拓扑结构的转变，其对孔隙介导和定向传热的影响在后续章节中分析。

fields.en: The authors propose a hypothesis that polymer fiber aerogels achieve continuous thermal insulation by designing molecules, forming fibers, assembling in three dimensions, and controlling the drying process to manipulate the thermal conduction pathways. This hypothesis is validated by comparing structural characteristics and testing conditions of different material systems, emphasizing the relationship between network stability and pore connectivity. The authors point out that effective molecular design requires balancing the synergistic effects of different functional groups and separating their functions through methods such as copolymerization and surface modification. The review analysis uses measurable structural descriptors and matched testing conditions, rather than relying solely on compositional labels, to ensure objectivity in comparison. By analyzing changes in fiber contact strength, pore distribution, and thermal conduction pathways, the authors verify the reliability of materials under service exposure. Each step of the analysis is based on evidence provided in the original text, such as p12, where mechanical reliability is determined by the strength and spatial distribution of critical fiber connection points, rather than an overall increase in solid content; p28, where network stability is achieved by controlling hydrogen bond formation and re-protonation; and p34, where functional separation through layered structures avoids overall densification. These steps ensure the transformation from laboratory samples to reusable insulation systems.
fields.zh: 作者提出假说，即聚合物纤维气凝胶通过分子设计、纤维形成、三维组装和干燥过程控制热传导路径，从而实现持续的热绝缘。该假说通过比较不同材料体系的结构特征和测试条件来验证，强调了网络稳定性与孔隙连通性的关系。作者指出，有效的分子设计需要平衡不同功能组的协同作用，并通过共聚、表面修饰等方法分离其功能。综述分析采用可测量的结构描述符和匹配的测试条件，而非仅依赖组成标签，以确保比较的客观性。通过分析纤维接触强度、孔隙分布和热传导路径的变化，作者验证了材料在服务暴露下的可靠性。每一步分析均基于原文提供的证据，如p12中提到的机械可靠性由关键纤维连接点的强度和空间分布决定，而非整体固含量增加；p28中通过控制氢键形成和再质子化实现网络稳定性；p34中通过分层结构分离功能以避免整体致密化。这些步骤确保了从实验室样品到可重复使用的绝缘系统的转化。

fields.en: My conclusion is that the experimental design of polymer fiber aerogels should focus on network formation and stability mechanisms, rather than single material properties. By controlling fiber contact, pore connectivity, and functional phase distribution, structural reliability can be achieved while maintaining low thermal conductivity. This principle applies to other porous material systems, such as bio-derived or composite materials, where thermal insulation performance can be optimized while ensuring mechanical properties and environmental adaptability.
fields.zh: 我的归纳是，聚合物纤维气凝胶的实验设计应围绕网络形成与稳定机制，而非单一材料属性。通过控制纤维接触、孔隙连通性及功能相分布，可在保持低热导的同时实现结构可靠性。该原则适用于其他多孔材料系统，如生物衍生或复合材料，在确保机械性能与环境适应性的前提下优化热绝缘性能。

fields.label_en: Why selected and what is innovative
fields.label_zh: 推荐理由与创新点（详细）
fields.en: This paper provides a comprehensive analysis of the thermal insulation properties of polymer fiber aerogels, from molecular design to structural reliability, emphasizing their ability to maintain good insulating performance even after service exposure. By comparing different material systems, it highlights that structural stability should be the core criterion, rather than solely relying on the initial sample's thermal conductivity. The key proposed in the paper lies in balancing network formation, interfacial stability, and pore control to ensure low thermal conduction paths are maintained under deformation, humidity, and fire conditions. For example, cellulose-based systems achieve high durability through optimized contact points and pore connectivity; aramid and PBO systems enhance mechanical properties and fire resistance by precisely controlling intermolecular forces. These design principles go beyond traditional line production modes, emphasizing the synergistic optimization of material properties and structural functions, rather than relying on a single performance indicator.
fields.zh: 该论文从分子设计到结构可靠性全面分析了聚合物纤维气凝胶的热绝缘性能，强调其在服务暴露后仍能保持良好保温效果。通过对比不同材料体系，指出应以结构稳定性为核心标准，而非单纯依赖原始样品导热系数。文中提出的关键在于平衡网络形成、界面稳定性和孔隙控制，确保在变形、湿度和火情下仍能维持低热传导路径。例如，纤维素基系统通过优化接触点和孔隙连通性实现高耐久性；芳纶和PBO体系则通过精确调控分子间作用力提升机械性能与防火能力。这些设计原则超越了传统流水线工作模式，强调材料特性与结构功能的协同优化，而非依赖单一性能指标。

fields.en: This paper explores the prospects of polymer fiber aerogels in the field of thermal insulation, emphasizing their potential to achieve low thermal conductivity and a durable porous architecture through molecular design and structural control. The material needs to maintain a sparse fibrous skeleton, local effective connection points, controllable pore connectivity, and spatially confined functions while ensuring stability and reliability under service conditions. Experimental results show that efficient thermal insulation performance can be achieved by optimizing fiber formation, interfacial stability, and drying processes. However, their application is limited by material processing conditions, environmental adaptability, and structural stability, requiring a balance between molecular design and process control.
fields.zh: 本文探讨了聚合物纤维气凝胶在热绝缘领域的应用前景，强调其通过分子设计和结构控制实现低导热性和持久孔隙架构的潜力。该材料需在保持稀疏纤维骨架、局部有效连接点、可控孔连通性及空间限域功能相的情况下，满足服务环境下的稳定性与可靠性。实验表明，通过优化纤维形成、界面稳定和干燥工艺，可实现高效热绝缘性能。然而，其应用受限于材料的加工条件、环境适应性和结构稳定性，需在分子设计与工艺控制间取得平衡。

fields.en: Future research should focus on how to optimize the stability of fiber networks and control thermal conduction pathways through molecular design and interface engineering, particularly under high humidity, high temperature, and fire exposure conditions. It is necessary to explore the mechanisms of structural retention of different material systems over their service life and verify their reliability in practical applications. Additionally, further research should be conducted on how to achieve controlled construction of anisotropic networks through directed drying and localized crosslinking, in order to enhance thermal insulation performance and mechanical strength.
fields.zh: 未来研究应聚焦于如何通过分子设计和界面工程优化纤维网络的稳定性与热传导路径控制，特别是在高湿度、高温及火暴露条件下。需探索不同材料体系在服务寿命内的结构保持机制，并验证其在实际应用中的可靠性。此外，应进一步研究如何通过定向干燥和局部交联实现各向异性网络的可控构建，以提升热绝缘性能与机械强度。

decisions.focus: Prediction of solubility of functionalised naphthalenes and rylenes in organic solvents using a visual programming framework

The paper presents a novel, accessible framework for predicting the solubility of functionalised naphthalenes and rylenes in organic solvents using a visual programming approach. The authors demonstrate that with sufficient high-quality training data, solubility can be effectively classified, highlighting the need for standardised characterisation procedures in supramolecular chemistry to develop more complex quantitative structure–property relationships. The framework is validated through a proof-of-concept dataset and shows potential for future applications in tailored design of functional materials.

classification_audit.abstract: The development of functional materials such as multilayer films from supramolecular self-assembling materials is hindered by the current lack of design principles and predictability. Quantitative structure–property relationships have emerged as a useful technique to tie properties of interest to the molecular structure across various applications but have not been widely explored in supramolecular material problems. Herein we describe and share an accessible, visual programming, classification framework which we have applied to the prediction of solubility of amino acid-functionalised napthalenes and rylenes. We show through a proof-of-concept dataset for amino acid-functionalised naphthalenes and rylenes that solubility can be effectively classified with sufficient high-quality training data, and highlight the need for standardised characterisation procedures in the field of supramolecular chemistry if more complex and informative quantitative structure–property relationships are to be developed. Such models could ultimately afford the tailored design of functional materials.

items.action:
本研究提出了一种易于使用的属性分类框架，用于预测功能化萘和瑞林在有机溶剂中的溶解性。该框架基于可视化编程平台KNIME开发，通过机器学习方法构建了定量结构-性质关系（QSPR）模型，并利用分子指纹描述符进行特征提取。研究团队展示了如何通过一个概念验证数据集对氨基酸功能化的萘和瑞林的溶解性进行有效分类，并强调了在超分子化学领域建立标准化表征程序的重要性，以促进更复杂和信息丰富的定量结构-性质关系的发展。该模型能够最终实现功能性材料的定制设计。

研究团队使用KNIME平台开发了一个稳健的QSPR框架，通过机器学习方法优化模型并利用多种统计指标进行评估。分子描述符包括九个物理化学特征和/或分子指纹特征，并通过RDKit Python包辅助完成模型可视化。模型可接受性域基于指纹距离度量，如Sahigara等人所述。验证库由代表之前报告的结构相似于训练化合物的SMILES生成，这些数据来自Reaxys®。

实验结果表明，在不同溶剂中，化合物被分类为溶解的百分比差异较大，例如在乙醚、二甲基亚砜、乙醇和四氢呋喃中分别为47%、83%、91%、44%和74%。通过分层分区准备训练集和测试集，并使用外部验证集进行评估。研究团队还展示了如何从大规模的虚拟库中预测萘和瑞林的溶解性，选择部分化合物合成并测试以作为验证集，证明了该方法在识别可溶和不可溶化合物方面的有效性。

本研究强调了在超分子化学领域建立标准化表征程序的重要性，并指出当前数据集的局限性可能影响模型的泛化能力。此外，研究团队建议未来应用该工作流程时应更有效地利用已分类属性，并通过重复分析减少实验误差对模型的影响。
items.research_logic: 作者通过构建一个可视化编程的分类框架，提出了一种预测功能化萘和瑞林在有机溶剂中溶解度的假说。该框架基于机器学习方法，利用交叉验证优化模型，并通过统计指标评估其性能。实验过程中，作者首先合成了一系列功能化萘和瑞林化合物，并使用紫外-可见光谱法测定其溶解度。随后，通过计算分子描述符和指纹特征，构建了QSPR模型，并采用Matthews相关系数作为分类模型的评估标准。在验证阶段，作者通过不同溶剂中化合物的分类分布，划分训练集与测试集，并利用外部验证集进一步检验模型的预测能力。同时，作者强调了数据标准化的重要性，以确保未来更复杂的定量结构-性质关系能够被开发。综述分析指出，为了有效构建QSPR模型，必须采用统一的表征方法和标准操作流程，以减少实验误差对结果的影响，并提高模型的统计效力。
items.own_synthesis: 我的归纳是，该研究通过构建可视化编程框架，提出了一种可迁移的实验设计原则：在预测复杂分子性质时，应采用标准化的表征流程和明确的分类阈值以减少信息损失。此原则适用于其他化学分类问题，但需注意数据集的局限性及模型泛化能力的边界。
items.selection_reason: 本文提出了一种基于可视化编程的分类框架，用于预测功能化萘和瑞林在有机溶剂中的溶解性。该方法通过机器学习模型和统计指标优化，实现了对分子结构与性质关系的有效建模。研究显示，通过设定合理的阈值和分类标准，可以有效区分溶解性和非溶解性化合物，并为未来更复杂的定量结构-性质关系开发提供基础。此外，文章强调了标准化表征程序的重要性，以确保数据的可重复性和模型的可靠性。该框架在溶剂兼容性预测中展现出潜力，能够帮助设计具有特定功能的多层薄膜材料。
items.application_prospects: 本文提出了一种基于可视化编程的QSPR框架，用于预测氨基酸功能化萘和苯并喹啉在有机溶剂中的溶解性。该方法通过机器学习模型和统计指标验证，展示了高精度的分类能力。研究指出，溶剂兼容性是设计多功能材料的关键因素，而标准化表征流程对于开发更复杂的QSPR模型至关重要。尽管当前模型在预测溶解性方面表现出色，但其应用仍受限于数据集规模和实验条件的一致性。未来需进一步优化模型以适应更多化学类别，并确保数据采集的可重复性和准确性。
items.future_directions: 本文提出了一种基于可视化编程的QSPR框架，用于预测氨基酸功能化萘和瑞利安在有机溶剂中的溶解性。未来研究可进一步探索如何通过扩展数据集以包含温度依赖性测量来提高模型的适用性，并开发更复杂的定量结构-性质关系。此外，应标准化表征程序以提升模型的准确性与可靠性。

fields.en:
This study proposes an easy-to-use property classification framework for predicting the solubility of functionalized naphthalene and rylene in organic solvents. The framework was developed based on a visual programming platform, KNIME, and constructs a quantitative structure-property relationship (QSPR) model through machine learning methods, utilizing molecular fingerprint descriptors for feature extraction. The research team demonstrated how to effectively classify the solubility of amino acid functionalized naphthalene and rylene using a concept validation dataset, and emphasized the importance of establishing standardized characterization procedures in supramolecular chemistry to promote the development of more complex and information-rich quantitative structure-property relationships. The model can ultimately enable the customized design of functional materials.

The research team developed a robust QSPR framework using the KNIME platform, optimizing the model through machine learning methods and evaluating it using multiple statistical metrics. The molecular descriptors include nine physicochemical features and/or molecular fingerprint features, and the model visualization is assisted by the RDKit Python package. The acceptability domain of the model is based on fingerprint distance measures as described by Sahigara et al. The validation library was generated from SMILES representing structures similar to the training compounds as reported previously, these data coming from Reaxys®.

The experimental results show that the percentage of compounds classified as soluble varies significantly in different solvents, for example, 47%, 83%, 91%, 44%, and 74% in ether, dimethyl sulfoxide, ethanol, and tetrahydrofuran, respectively. The training set and test set were prepared using stratified partitioning, and evaluated using an external validation set. The research team also demonstrated how to predict the solubility of naphthalene and rynin from a large virtual library, selecting some compounds for synthesis and testing as the validation set, proving the effectiveness of the method in identifying soluble and insoluble compounds.

This study emphasizes the importance of establishing standardized characterization protocols in supramolecular chemistry and points out that the limitations of current datasets may affect the generalization ability of models. Additionally, the research team suggests that future applications of this workflow should more effectively utilize classified properties and reduce the impact of experimental errors on the model by conducting repeated analyses.

fields.en: The author proposes a hypothesis for predicting the solubility of functionalized naphthalenes and rylene compounds in organic solvents by constructing a visual programming classification framework. This framework is based on machine learning methods, utilizing cross-validation to optimize the model and evaluating its performance through statistical metrics. During the experiment, the author first synthesized a series of functionalized naphthalene and rylene compounds and measured their solubility using UV-visible spectroscopy. Subsequently, by calculating molecular descriptors and fingerprint features, a QSPR model was constructed, and the Matthews correlation coefficient was used as the evaluation standard for the classification model. In the validation stage, the author divided the training set and test set based on the distribution of compounds in different solvents, and further tested the predictive ability of the model using an external validation set. At the same time, the author emphasized the importance of data standardization to ensure that more complex quantitative structure-property relationships can be developed in the future. A review analysis indicates that in order to effectively construct a QSPR model, a unified representation method and standard operating procedure must be adopted to reduce the impact of experimental errors on results and improve the statistical power of the model.

paragraphs.en: The author proposes a hypothesis for predicting the solubility of functionalized naphthalenes and rylene compounds in organic solvents by constructing a visual programming classification framework. This framework is based on machine learning methods, utilizing cross-validation to optimize the model and evaluating its performance through statistical metrics. During the experiment, the author first synthesized a series of functionalized naphthalene and rylene compounds and measured their solubility using UV-visible spectroscopy. Subsequently, by calculating molecular descriptors and fingerprint features, a QSPR model was constructed, and the Matthews correlation coefficient was used as the evaluation standard for the classification model. In the validation stage, the author divided the training set and test set based on the distribution of compounds in different solvents, and further tested the predictive ability of the model using an external validation set. At the same time, the author emphasized the importance of data standardization to ensure that more complex quantitative structure-property relationships can be developed in the future. A review analysis indicates that in order to effectively construct a QSPR model, a unified representation method and standard operating procedure must be adopted to reduce the impact of experimental errors on results and improve the statistical power of the model.

fields.en: This paper proposes a classification framework based on visual programming for predicting the solubility of functionalized naphthalenes and rylene in organic solvents. The method achieves effective modeling of the relationship between molecular structure and properties through optimization of machine learning models and statistical indicators. The study shows that by setting reasonable thresholds and classification criteria, it is possible to effectively distinguish soluble and non-soluble compounds, providing a foundation for future more complex quantitative structure-property relationships. Furthermore, the paper emphasizes the importance of standardized representation procedures to ensure the repeatability of data and the reliability of the model. This framework demonstrates potential in solvent compatibility prediction, helping to design multilayer film materials with specific functions.

fields.en: This paper proposes a QSPR framework based on visual programming for predicting the solubility of functionalized naphthalene and benzofuran in organic solvents. The method is validated through machine learning models and statistical indicators, demonstrating high precision in classification. The study highlights that solvent compatibility is a key factor in designing multifunctional materials, and standardized characterization procedures are essential for developing more complex QSPR models. Although the current model performs well in predicting solubility, its application is still limited by the size of the dataset and consistency of experimental conditions. Future work requires further optimization of the model to accommodate more chemical classes and ensure the repeatability and accuracy of data collection.
fields.zh: 本文提出了一种基于可视化编程的QSPR框架，用于预测氨基酸功能化萘和苯并喹啉在有机溶剂中的溶解性。该方法通过机器学习模型和统计指标验证，展示了高精度的分类能力。研究指出，溶剂兼容性是设计多功能材料的关键因素，而标准化表征流程对于开发更复杂的QSPR模型至关重要。尽管当前模型在预测溶解性方面表现出色，但其应用仍受限于数据集规模和实验条件的一致性。未来需进一步优化模型以适应更多化学类别，并确保数据采集的可重复性和准确性。

classification_audit.abstract: Abstract Flavor molecules are commonly used in the food industry to enhance product quality and consumer experiences but are associated with potential human health risks, highlighting the need for safer alternatives. To address these health-associated challenges and promote reasonable application, several databases for flavor molecules have been constructed. However, no existing studies have comprehensively summarized these data resources according to quality, focused fields, and potential gaps. Here, we systematically summarized 25 flavor molecule databases published within the last 20 years and revealed that data inaccessibility, untimely updates, and nonstandard flavor descriptions are the main limitations of current studies. We examined the development of computational approaches (e.g., machine learning and molecular simulation) for the identification of novel flavor molecules and discussed their major challenges regarding throughput, model interpretability, and the lack of gold-standard data sets for equitable model evaluation. Additionally, we discussed future strategies for the mining and designing of novel flavor molecules based on multi-omics and artificial intelligence to provide a new foundation for flavor science research. Keywords: bioinformatics, cheminformatics, machine learning, database, active ingredients

items.action:
风味分子在食品工业中广泛用于增强产品的质量和消费者的体验，但它们与潜在的人类健康风险相关，凸显了寻找更安全替代品的必要性。本文系统总结了过去20年内发表的25个风味分子数据库，并揭示了当前研究的主要局限性：数据不可用、更新不及时和非标准化的风味描述。我们考察了计算方法（如机器学习和分子模拟）在识别新风味分子中的发展，讨论了其主要挑战，包括通量、模型可解释性和缺乏标准数据集的问题。此外，我们还讨论了基于多组学和人工智能的未来策略，以挖掘和设计新的风味分子，为风味科学研究提供新基础。关键词：生物信息学、化学信息学、机器学习、数据库、活性成分。

在风味分子数据库中，我们检索了Scopus、PubMed、Web of Science和Google Scholar等学术数据库中的相关数据，共获取25个数据库，其中14个包含味觉分子，9个包含嗅觉分子，2个包含两者。这些数据库包含了分子名称、化学抽象服务（CAS）注册号、简化分子输入线性系统（SMILES）格式的分子结构和风味描述。此外，我们还讨论了当前数据库的局限性和未来发展方向，如数据可重复性差、更新不及时以及非标准化的描述等问题。

基于计算策略，如机器学习和分子模拟，可以用于识别新的风味分子，并通过多组学和人工智能技术进一步挖掘和设计新的风味分子。这些方法为风味科学提供了新的研究基础，但目前仍存在数据可重复性差、更新不及时以及非标准化的描述等问题。未来的研究应关注如何改进数据库的质量和完整性，以更好地支持风味分子的研究和应用。

综上所述，本文系统总结了当前风味分子数据库的发展现状，并指出了其存在的主要问题。通过计算策略和多组学技术的应用，可以进一步挖掘和设计新的风味分子，为风味科学提供新的研究基础。
items.research_logic: 作者通过系统梳理25个风味分子数据库，揭示了当前研究的局限性，并提出基于计算策略的解决方案。首先，作者从学术数据库中检索出25个数据库，发现数据不可用、更新不及时和非标准描述是主要问题。接着，作者分析了计算方法（如机器学习和分子模拟）在识别新风味分子中的应用，并讨论了其挑战。随后，作者提出未来策略，基于多组学和人工智能挖掘和设计新型风味分子。通过关键词共现网络分析文献，发现数据库和分子鉴定的关键词分布，揭示了研究热点。最后，作者提供数据集供进一步使用，强调数据共享的重要性。这些步骤有助于全面评估当前研究状态，并为未来研究提供方向。
items.own_synthesis: 我的归纳是，数据驱动的风味化学研究需要构建标准化、可更新的数据库，并结合计算方法提升分子识别效率。当前数据库存在数据不可用、更新不及时和描述非标准的问题，限制了其在工业中的应用。通过多组学与人工智能技术，可以开发更高效的分子筛选和设计策略，但需注意数据质量与标注完整性。该原则适用于其他生物分子数据库建设，尤其在跨学科研究中具有参考价值。
items.selection_reason: 本文推荐理由基于其对风味分子数据库的系统综述与数据驱动方法的应用。文章详细分析了当前风味分子数据库存在的主要问题，如数据不可用性、更新不及时和非标准化描述，并探讨了计算方法（如机器学习和分子模拟）在识别新风味分子中的潜力及挑战。同时，文章提出了未来基于多组学和人工智能的策略，以挖掘和设计新型风味分子，为风味科学提供新的研究基础。文中引用的数据库涵盖了多个领域，包括甜味、苦味、酸味、咸味和辛辣味分子，以及芳香分子，展示了其全面性和多样性。这些数据库不仅提供了丰富的数据资源，还指出了当前研究中的不足之处，如对非甜/非苦味分子的关注不足及气味分子分类的不标准问题。综上所述，本文通过系统分析和深入讨论，为风味科学的发展提供了有价值的参考和指导。
items.application_prospects: 本文探讨了风味分子数据库在化学领域的应用前景，指出当前数据不可用、更新不及时和非标准化描述是主要限制。通过综合分析25个风味分子数据库，发现计算方法如机器学习和分子模拟在识别新型风味分子方面有潜力，但面临数据集缺乏和模型可解释性问题。未来需结合多组学与人工智能进一步挖掘和设计新型风味分子，以提供新的研究基础。
items.future_directions: 本文指出当前风味分子数据库存在数据不可用、更新不及时和非标准描述等主要限制，未来应通过多组学与人工智能技术进一步挖掘和设计新型风味分子。建议探索基于计算策略的风味分子筛选与设计方法，并关注 sour, salty, 和 spicy 味觉分子的标注问题。此外，需解决气味分子与蛋白质/基因的相互作用数据缺失问题，以提升数据库的应用价值。

fields.en:
Flavor molecules are widely used in the food industry to enhance product quality and consumer experience, but they are associated with potential human health risks, highlighting the necessity of seeking safer alternatives. This paper systematically summarizes 25 flavor molecule databases published over the past 20 years and reveals the main limitations of current research: unavailable data, outdated updates, and non-standardized flavor descriptions. We examine the development of computational methods (such as machine learning and molecular simulation) in identifying new flavor molecules, discuss their major challenges, including throughput, model interpretability, and the lack of standard datasets. Furthermore, we also discuss future strategies based on multi-omics and artificial intelligence to explore and design new flavor molecules, providing a new foundation for flavor science research. Keywords: bioinformatics, chemical informatics, machine learning, database, active ingredients.

In the flavor molecule database, we retrieved relevant data from academic databases such as Scopus, PubMed, Web of Science, and Google Scholar, obtaining data from 25 databases. Among them, 14 contain taste molecules, 9 contain odor molecules, and 2 contain both. These databases include molecular names, Chemical Abstracts Service (CAS) registration numbers, simplified molecular input line notation (SMILES) format of molecular structures, and flavor descriptions. Furthermore, we discussed the limitations and future directions of current databases, such as poor data reproducibility, outdated updates, and non-standardized descriptions.

Based on computational strategies such as machine learning and molecular simulation, new flavor molecules can be identified, and further exploration and design of new flavor molecules can be conducted through multi-omics and artificial intelligence technologies. These methods provide a new research foundation for flavor science, but there are still issues such as poor data reproducibility, outdated information, and non-standard descriptions currently. Future research should focus on how to improve the quality and completeness of databases to better support the study and application of flavor molecules.

In summary, this paper systematically summarizes the current development status of flavor molecular databases and points out their main problems. By applying computational strategies and multi-omics technologies, new flavor molecules can be further explored and designed, providing a new research foundation for flavor science.
fields.zh:
风味分子在食品工业中广泛用于增强产品的质量和消费者的体验，但它们与潜在的人类健康风险相关，凸显了寻找更安全替代品的必要性。本文系统总结了过去20年内发表的25个风味分子数据库，并揭示了当前研究的主要局限性：数据不可用、更新不及时和非标准化的风味描述。我们考察了计算方法（如机器学习和分子模拟）在识别新风味分子中的发展，讨论了其主要挑战，包括通量、模型可解释性和缺乏标准数据集的问题。此外，我们还讨论了基于多组学和人工智能的未来策略，以挖掘和设计新的风味分子，为风味科学研究提供新基础。关键词：生物信息学、化学信息学、机器学习、数据库、活性成分。

在风味分子数据库中，我们检索了Scopus、PubMed、Web of Science和Google Scholar等学术数据库中的相关数据，共获取25个数据库，其中14个包含味觉分子，9个包含嗅觉分子，2个包含两者。这些数据库包含了分子名称、化学抽象服务（CAS）注册号、简化分子输入线性系统（SMILES）格式的分子结构和风味描述。此外，我们还讨论了当前数据库的局限性和未来发展方向，如数据可重复性差、更新不及时以及非标准化的描述等问题。

基于计算策略，如机器学习和分子模拟，可以用于识别新的风味分子，并通过多组学和人工智能技术进一步挖掘和设计新的风味分子。这些方法为风味科学提供了新的研究基础，但目前仍存在数据可重复性差、更新不及时以及非标准化的描述等问题。未来的研究应关注如何改进数据库的质量和完整性，以更好地支持风味分子的研究和应用。

综上所述，本文系统总结了当前风味分子数据库的发展现状，并指出了其存在的主要问题。通过计算策略和多组学技术的应用，可以进一步挖掘和设计新的风味分子，为风味科学提供新的研究基础。

fields.en: The author systematically reviewed 25 flavor molecule databases to reveal the limitations of current research and proposed solutions based on computational strategies. First, the author retrieved 25 databases from academic sources and found that data unavailability, outdated updates, and non-standard descriptions were the main issues. Next, the author analyzed the application of computational methods (such as machine learning and molecular simulation) in identifying new flavor molecules and discussed their challenges. Then, the author proposed future strategies based on multi-omics and artificial intelligence to explore and design novel flavor molecules. By analyzing keyword co-occurrence networks in literature, the distribution of keywords related to databases and molecule identification was revealed, highlighting research hotspots. Finally, the author provided a dataset for further use, emphasizing the importance of data sharing. These steps help comprehensively evaluate the current state of research and provide directions for future studies.

fields.en: My conclusion is that data-driven flavor chemistry research needs to build standardized, updatable databases and combine computational methods to enhance molecular recognition efficiency. The current databases have issues with data unavailability, outdated updates, and non-standard descriptions, limiting their application in industry. By integrating multi-omics and artificial intelligence technologies, more efficient strategies for molecular screening and design can be developed, but attention must be paid to data quality and annotation completeness. This principle applies to the construction of other biological molecule databases, particularly in interdisciplinary research.

fields.en: The recommendation of this paper is based on its systematic review of the flavor molecule database and the application of data-driven methods. The paper provides a detailed analysis of the main issues existing in current flavor molecule databases, such as data unavailability, outdated updates, and non-standard descriptions. It also explores the potential and challenges of computational methods (such as machine learning and molecular simulation) in identifying new flavor molecules. Meanwhile, the paper proposes future strategies based on multi-omics and artificial intelligence to explore and design novel flavor molecules, providing a new research foundation for flavor science. The databases cited in the paper cover multiple fields, including sweet, bitter, sour, salty, and spicy molecule compounds, as well as aromatic molecules, demonstrating their comprehensiveness and diversity. These databases not only provide rich data resources but also highlight current shortcomings in research, such as insufficient attention to non-sweet/non-bitter molecules and non-standard classification of odor molecules. In conclusion, this paper provides valuable references and guidance for the development of flavor science through systematic analysis and in-depth discussion.
fields.zh: 本文推荐理由基于其对风味分子数据库的系统综述与数据驱动方法的应用。文章详细分析了当前风味分子数据库存在的主要问题，如数据不可用性、更新不及时和非标准化描述，并探讨了计算方法（如机器学习和分子模拟）在识别新风味分子中的潜力及挑战。同时，文章提出了未来基于多组学和人工智能的策略，以挖掘和设计新型风味分子，为风味科学提供新的研究基础。文中引用的数据库涵盖了多个领域，包括甜味、苦味、酸味、咸味和辛辣味分子，以及芳香分子，展示了其全面性和多样性。这些数据库不仅提供了丰富的数据资源，还指出了当前研究中的不足之处，如对非甜/非苦味分子的关注不足及气味分子分类的不标准问题。综上所述，本文通过系统分析和深入讨论，为风味科学的发展提供了有价值的参考和指导。

fields.en: This paper explores the prospects of flavor molecule databases in the field of chemistry, pointing out that the main limitations are the current lack of data, outdated updates, and non-standard descriptions. Through a comprehensive analysis of 25 flavor molecule databases, it is found that computational methods such as machine learning and molecular simulation have potential in identifying new flavor molecules, but face challenges such as limited datasets and issues with model interpretability. Future research needs to combine multi-omics with artificial intelligence to further explore and design new flavor molecules, providing a new research foundation.
fields.zh: 本文探讨了风味分子数据库在化学领域的应用前景，指出当前数据不可用、更新不及时和非标准化描述是主要限制。通过综合分析25个风味分子数据库，发现计算方法如机器学习和分子模拟在识别新型风味分子方面有潜力，但面临数据集缺乏和模型可解释性问题。未来需结合多组学与人工智能进一步挖掘和设计新型风味分子，以提供新的研究基础。

fields.en: This paper points out that the current flavor molecule database has major limitations such as data unavailability, outdated updates, and non-standard descriptions. In the future, it is recommended to further explore and design new flavor molecules through multi-omics and artificial intelligence technologies. It is suggested to explore screening and design methods of flavor molecules based on computational strategies, and pay attention to the annotation issues of sour, salty, and spicy taste molecules. Additionally, it is necessary to solve the problem of missing data on the interaction between odor molecules and proteins/genes in order to enhance the application value of the database.
fields.zh: 本文指出当前风味分子数据库存在数据不可用、更新不及时和非标准描述等主要限制，未来应通过多组学与人工智能技术进一步挖掘和设计新型风味分子。建议探索基于计算策略的风味分子筛选与设计方法，并关注 sour, salty, 和 spicy 味觉分子的标注问题。此外，需解决气味分子与蛋白质/基因的相互作用数据缺失问题，以提升数据库的应用价值。

decisions.focus: Influence of Ru content on defect formation and electrocatalytic activity in Au‐Pd‐Pt‐Ru CCSS thin films for the hydrogen evolution reaction

This study provides a detailed investigation into how Ru content influences defect formation and electrocatalytic activity in Au‐Pd‐Pt‐Ru CCSS thin films for the hydrogen evolution reaction (HER). The research focuses on the role of planar defects, such as nanotwins and stacking faults, in modulating catalytic performance. By employing high-throughput characterization techniques including electron microscopy, X-ray diffraction, and electrochemical screening, the study correlates composition, microstructure, and defect formation with catalytic activity. The findings highlight that Ru content can tune surface energy for hydrogen adsorption through interactions with neighboring atoms, suggesting a new insight into surface atom arrangement design in CCSS electrocatalysts.

classification_audit.abstract: ABSTRACT Compositionally complex solid solutions (CCSSs) consist of a randomly mixed single phase with the potential to enhance electrocatalytic activity through their polyelemental surface atom arrangements. Local structure, chemistry, and lattice strain variation can affect electrocatalytic activity. We investigate the effect of Ru content on defect formation and electrochemistry in Au‐Pd‐Pt‐Ru CCSS thin films. A thin‐film material library covering a wide composition range was fabricated by room‐temperature combinatorial co‐sputtering. High‐throughput characterization, including electron microscopy, X‐ray diffraction, and electrochemical screening, were used to correlate composition and microstructural features with catalytic activity. Three representative compositions – Au 68 Pd 13 Pt 15 Ru 4 , Au 27 Pd 23 Pt 24 Ru 26 , and Au 9 Pd 21 Pt 18 Ru 52 – were examined. The samples exhibit face‐centered cubic crystal structures, with lattice contraction occurring and a transition from a high density of nanotwins to high‐density stacking faults with increasing Ru content. These planar defects could influence electrocatalytic activity when they terminate at surfaces. Moreover, the hydrogen evolution reaction activity improves with higher Ru content, suggesting that Ru can tune the surface energy for hydrogen adsorption through interactions with neighboring atoms. Atom probe tomography reveals local compositional fluctuations at grain boundaries depending on the Ru content. The findings provide a new insight into surface atom arrangement design in the CCSS electrocatalysts with enhanced performance.

items.action:
本研究探讨了Ru含量对Au-Pd-Pt-Ru组分复杂固溶体薄膜中缺陷形成及析氢反应（HER）电催化性能的影响。通过高通量方法，结合扫描电子显微镜、X射线衍射和扫描滴定池测量，研究者分析了不同Ru含量下薄膜的化学组成与晶体结构之间的关系。实验选取了三种代表性成分：Au 68 Pd 13 Pt 15 Ru 4、Au 27 Pd 23 Pt 24 Ru 26 和 Au 9 Pd 21 Pt 18 Ru 52，发现随着Ru含量增加，薄膜的晶格收缩并出现从高密度纳米孪晶向高密度堆垛层错的转变。这些平面缺陷可能影响电催化活性，尤其是在它们终止于表面时。原子探针显微术揭示了在晶界处由于Ru含量不同而产生的局部组成波动。研究结果表明，Ru可以通过与邻近原子相互作用调节表面能以促进氢吸附，从而提高HER性能。此外，Ru富集的薄膜表现出高密度的堆垛层错，这些缺陷可能改变活性位点并影响电催化反应。本研究为设计具有增强性能的组分复杂固溶体电催化剂提供了新的见解。

实验中通过磁控共溅射法制备了覆盖广泛成分范围的薄膜材料库，并利用高通量方法分析了不同Ru含量下的缺陷形成与电催化性能之间的关系。原子探针显微术进一步揭示了晶界处局部原子波动，支持了对组分复杂固溶体薄膜中组成和微观结构复杂性的理解。研究结果表明，Ru的含量变化不仅影响表面原子排列，还可能通过改变晶界处的组成分布来影响电化学活性。

本研究发现，在Ru富集的薄膜中，高密度的堆垛层错形成并延伸至表面，可能修改其原子结构，从而影响电催化性能。而Ru在晶界处的贫乏则表明其更倾向于溶解于体积内而非聚集于表面，这说明更高的Ru含量可能存在于晶粒内部并导致晶格应变。这些发现为设计具有优化组成和微观结构复杂性的组分复杂固溶体电催化剂提供了理论依据。

研究结果表明，Ru含量的增加不仅影响了薄膜的晶体结构和缺陷形成，还通过改变表面原子排列和晶界处的组成分布来调节电催化活性。这种调控机制为开发高性能的析氢反应电催化剂提供了新的思路。
items.research_logic: 作者通过构建Au-Pd-Pt-Ru组成复杂固溶体薄膜材料库，系统研究了Ru含量对缺陷形成及电催化性能的影响。首先，利用高通量方法确定了不同Ru含量下的化学组成和晶体结构，验证了Ru含量与表面缺陷之间的关联性。随后，通过高分辨透射电子显微镜（HR-TEM）分析发现，随着Ru含量增加，纳米孪晶和堆垛层错（SFs）密度显著提高，并终止于表面，可能影响电催化活性。原子探针显微术（APT）进一步揭示了晶界处的局部组成波动，表明Ru在晶内富集而非晶界偏聚，从而改变晶格应变。综述分析通过对比不同Ru含量下的缺陷类型和分布，强调了表面终止缺陷对催化活性的关键作用，并指出需综合考虑组成与微观结构复杂性以优化电催化剂设计。
items.own_synthesis: 我的归纳是，本研究通过调控Ru含量，揭示了CCSS电催化剂中平面缺陷对HER活性的影响机制。Ru的加入不仅改变了表面原子排列，还通过形成纳米孪晶和堆垛层错等平面缺陷，影响了局部晶体结构与催化位点。该实验设计表明，在多元素固溶体中，通过控制缺陷类型和分布可优化电催化性能，适用于其他复杂合金体系的催化剂设计。但此机制仅在高Ru含量且表面缺陷终止于界面时有效，不适用于低含量或非界面环境。
items.selection_reason: 本研究通过高通量方法系统分析了Ru含量对Au-Pd-Pt-Ru组成复杂固溶体薄膜中缺陷形成及析氢反应（HER）电催化活性的影响。重点探讨了平面缺陷（如纳米孪晶和堆垛层错）在不同Ru含量下的形成机制及其对表面原子排列的调控作用。研究发现，随着Ru含量增加，薄膜中出现高密度的平面缺陷，这些缺陷终止于表面时会改变局部晶格结构和活性位点分布，从而影响电催化性能。通过高分辨透射电子显微镜（HR-TEM）和原子探针层析术（APT）分析，证实了Ru在晶界处的富集或贫乏现象与平面缺陷形成能差异有关。研究结果表明，Ru含量调控可优化表面能量，促进氢吸附，为复杂固溶体电催化剂的设计提供了理论依据。
items.application_prospects: 本文研究了Ru含量对Au-Pd-Pt-Ru组成复杂固溶体薄膜中缺陷形成和析氢反应（HER）电催化活性的影响，发现Ru能通过与邻近原子相互作用调节表面能量，促进平面缺陷如纳米孪晶和堆垛层错的形成。这些缺陷终止于表面时会影响局部晶格结构和表面原子排列，从而影响电催化性能。研究还表明，在等原子和富Ru薄膜中，高密度的平面缺陷存在，且这些缺陷与基体具有相干边界，可能改变活性位点分布。该研究为设计具有高组成复杂性和微结构复杂性的CCSS电催化剂提供了理论依据。
items.future_directions: 本文研究了Ru含量对Au-Pd-Pt-Ru组成复杂固溶体薄膜中缺陷形成和电催化性能的影响，特别关注平面缺陷在Ru含量增加时的变化。未来可进一步探讨特定平面缺陷终止于表面时对电催化活性的具体作用机制，并设计实验验证不同Ru含量下平面缺陷对氢吸附能的调控效果。

fields.en:
This study explores the effect of Ru content on the formation of defects and electrocatalytic performance of hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) in complex solid solutions thin films of Au-Pd-Pt-Ru components. By combining high-throughput methods with scanning electron microscopy, X-ray diffraction, and scanning drop cell measurements, researchers analyzed the relationship between the chemical composition and crystal structure of the films under different Ru contents. The experiments selected three representative compositions: Au 68 Pd 13 Pt 15 Ru 4, Au 27 Pd 23 Pt 24 Ru 26, and Au 9 Pd 21 Pt 18 Ru 52. It was found that as the Ru content increased, the lattice contracted and a transition from high-density nanotwins to high-density stacking faults occurred. These planar defects may affect electrocatalytic activity, especially when they terminate at the surface. Atomic probe tomography revealed local composition fluctuations due to different Ru contents at grain boundaries. The results show that Ru can regulate surface energy by interacting with neighboring atoms to promote hydrogen adsorption, thereby enhancing HER performance. Furthermore, Ru-enriched films exhibit high-density stacking faults, which may alter active sites and affect electrocatalytic reactions. This study provides new insights into the design of complex solid solution electrocatalysts with enhanced performance.

A film material library with a wide range of compositions was prepared through magnetron sputtering in the experiment, and high-throughput methods were used to analyze the relationship between defect formation and electrocatalytic performance under different Ru contents. Atomic probe tomography further revealed local atomic fluctuations at grain boundaries, supporting the understanding of the complexity of composition and microstructure in complex solid solutions. The results show that variations in Ru content not only affect surface atomic arrangement but may also influence electrochemical activity by altering the compositional distribution at grain boundaries.

This study found that in Ru-enriched films, high-density stacking faults form and extend to the surface, possibly modifying their atomic structure, thereby affecting electrocatalytic performance. The depletion of Ru at grain boundaries indicates a preference for dissolution into the volume rather than aggregation at the surface, suggesting that higher Ru content may exist within grain interiors and cause lattice strain. These findings provide theoretical basis for designing component-complex solid solutions with optimized composition and microstructural complexity as electrocatalysts.

The study results show that the increase of Ru content not only affects the crystal structure and defect formation of the film, but also regulates the electrocatalytic activity by altering the surface atomic arrangement and composition distribution at grain boundaries. This regulatory mechanism provides new insights for developing high-performance hydrogen evolution reaction catalysts.

本研究探讨了Ru含量对Au-Pd-Pt-Ru组分复杂固溶体薄膜中缺陷形成及析氢反应（HER）电催化性能的影响。通过高通量方法，结合扫描电子显微镜、X射线衍射和扫描滴定池测量，研究者分析了不同Ru含量下薄膜的化学组成与晶体结构之间的关系。实验选取了三种代表性成分：Au 68 Pd 13 Pt 15 Ru 4、Au 27 Pd 23 Pt 24 Ru 26 和 Au 9 Pd 21 Pt 18 Ru 52，发现随着Ru含量增加，薄膜的晶格收缩并出现从高密度纳米孪晶向高密度堆垛层错的转变。这些平面缺陷可能影响电催化活性，尤其是在它们终止于表面时。原子探针显微术揭示了在晶界处由于Ru含量不同而产生的局部组成波动。研究结果表明，Ru可以通过与邻近原子相互作用调节表面能以促进氢吸附，从而提高HER性能。此外，Ru富集的薄膜表现出高密度的堆垛层错，这些缺陷可能改变活性位点并影响电催化反应。本研究为设计具有增强性能的组分复杂固溶体电催化剂提供了新的见解。

实验中通过磁控共溅射法制备了覆盖广泛成分范围的薄膜材料库，并利用高通量方法分析了不同Ru含量下的缺陷形成与电催化性能之间的关系。原子探针显微术进一步揭示了晶界处局部原子波动，支持了对组分复杂固溶体薄膜中组成和微观结构复杂性的理解。研究结果表明，Ru的含量变化不仅影响表面原子排列，还可能通过改变晶界处的组成分布来影响电化学活性。

本研究发现，在Ru富集的薄膜中，高密度的堆垛层错形成并延伸至表面，可能修改其原子结构，从而影响电催化性能。而Ru在晶界处的贫乏则表明其更倾向于溶解于体积内而非聚集于表面，这说明更高的Ru含量可能存在于晶粒内部并导致晶格应变。这些发现为设计具有优化组成和微观结构复杂性的组分复杂固溶体电催化剂提供了理论依据。

研究结果表明，Ru含量的增加不仅影响了薄膜的晶体结构和缺陷形成，还通过改变表面原子排列和晶界处的组成分布来调节电催化活性。这种调控机制为开发高性能的析氢反应电催化剂提供了新的思路。

fields.en: The author constructed a complex solid solution thin film library composed of Au-Pd-Pt-Ru to systematically study the effects of Ru content on defect formation and electrocatalytic performance. First, using a high-throughput method, the chemical composition and crystal structure were determined for different Ru contents, verifying the correlation between Ru content and surface defects. Subsequently, high-resolution transmission electron microscopy (HR-TEM) analysis revealed that with increasing Ru content, the density of nanotwin and stacking faults (SFs) significantly increased and terminated at the surface, which may affect electrocatalytic activity. Atomic probe tomography (APT) further revealed local compositional fluctuations at grain boundaries, indicating that Ru was enriched within the grains rather than preferentially accumulated at grain boundaries, thereby altering lattice strain. A review analysis by comparing different Ru contents' defect types and distributions emphasized the critical role of surface terminating defects in catalytic activity and highlighted the need to comprehensively consider the complexity of composition and microstructure to optimize electrocatalyst design.
fields.zh: 作者通过构建Au-Pd-Pt-Ru组成复杂固溶体薄膜材料库，系统研究了Ru含量对缺陷形成及电催化性能的影响。首先，利用高通量方法确定了不同Ru含量下的化学组成和晶体结构，验证了Ru含量与表面缺陷之间的关联性。随后，通过高分辨透射电子显微镜（HR-TEM）分析发现，随着Ru含量增加，纳米孪晶和堆垛层错（SFs）密度显著提高，并终止于表面，可能影响电催化活性。原子探针显微术（APT）进一步揭示了晶界处的局部组成波动，表明Ru在晶内富集而非晶界偏聚，从而改变晶格应变。综述分析通过对比不同Ru含量下的缺陷类型和分布，强调了表面终止缺陷对催化活性的关键作用，并指出需综合考虑组成与微观结构复杂性以优化电催化剂设计。

fields.en: My conclusion is that this study reveals the mechanism of the effect of planar defects on HER activity in CCSS electrocatalysts by regulating the Ru content. The addition of Ru not only changes the arrangement of surface atoms but also affects the local crystal structure and catalytic sites through the formation of nanotwin and stacking fault-like planar defects. This experimental design indicates that in multi-element solid solutions, optimizing electrocatalytic performance is achievable by controlling defect types and distribution, which is applicable to the design of catalysts for other complex alloy systems. However, this mechanism is only effective when Ru content is high and surface defects terminate at the interface, and it is not applicable for low Ru content or non-interface environments.

fields.label_en: Why selected and what is innovative
fields.label_zh: 推荐理由与创新点（详细）
fields.en: This study systematically analyzed the effects of Ru content on the formation of defects and the electrocatalytic activity for hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) in complex solid solutions of Au-Pd-Pt-Ru thin films using high-throughput methods. The focus was on exploring the formation mechanisms of planar defects (such as nanotwins and stacking faults) under different Ru contents and their regulatory effects on surface atomic arrangements. The study found that with increasing Ru content, high-density planar defects appear in the film. When these defects terminate at the surface, they alter the local lattice structure and distribution of active sites, thereby affecting electrocatalytic performance. Through high-resolution transmission electron microscopy (HR-TEM) and atom probe tomography (APT) analysis, it was confirmed that the enrichment or depletion of Ru at grain boundaries is related to the difference in planar defect formation energy. The results show that Ru content regulation can optimize surface energy and promote hydrogen adsorption, providing theoretical basis for the design of complex solid solution electrocatalysts.

paragraphs.en: This study systematically analyzed the effects of Ru content on the formation of defects and the electrocatalytic activity for hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) in complex solid solutions of Au-Pd-Pt-Ru thin films using high-throughput methods. The focus was on exploring the formation mechanisms of planar defects (such as nanotwins and stacking faults) under different Ru contents and their regulatory effects on surface atomic arrangements. The study found that with increasing Ru content, high-density planar defects appear in the film. When these defects terminate at the surface, they alter the local lattice structure and distribution of active sites, thereby affecting electrocatalytic performance. Through high-resolution transmission electron microscopy (HR-TEM) and atom probe tomography (APT) analysis, it was confirmed that the enrichment or depletion of Ru at grain boundaries is related to the difference in planar defect formation energy. The results show that Ru content regulation can optimize surface energy and promote hydrogen adsorption, providing theoretical basis for the design of complex solid solution electrocatalysts.
